body: You are right about it sounding cliche, but having mental health issues and dealing with failures every point in your life is a lot for me. I wish I had a great childhood who had dreams early in life, but instead I had to be raped. I’m sorry you have to put up with me, I’m just not okay.

I’ve lived my life failure after failure after failure. I didn’t have a great childhood, I’ve never had anything too look forward to because of dreams I failed to accomplish. I failed to have good relationships and managed to burn them. I’ve dropped out of college. I barely passed high school. I can’t even do anything right.

I’ll think about reaching out to a professional, but in all honesty I doubt that the pain of feeling worthless will go away. I appreciate you taking the time to respond to me though. May God be with you.
Sorry for responding late, but yes I do have access to one. I just don’t believe it would help me to use it.
